info.name: SGITU - G10 Gateway x G5 Notifications
info.description: Collection Postman complete pour verifier la relation Client -> G10 -> G5 Notifications. Elle couvre health public, JWT, RBAC admin, envoi notification LOG, consultation, retry, filtres admin, erreurs 400/401/403 et resilience 503.

exec: const payload = { sub: email, userId: String(userId), roles: roles, iat: now, exp: now + ttlSeconds, jti: 'g5-postman-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) };
pm.test('G5 health via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Sans JWT refuse par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('ROLE_PASSENGER refuse sur admin G5', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('List accessible with JWT', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Stats body', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('total'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('byStatus'); });
pm.test('Admin list body is pageable/array', function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(rows)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Force retry admin retourne 200 ou 404 si aucune notification disponible', function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Delete admin retourne 200 ou 404 si deja absente', function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 04.1 - G5 down -> 503 via G10
item.description: Avant ce test manuel : docker stop sgitu-int-notification-service. Si G5 tourne encore, la reponse peut etre 200.

exec: pm.test('G5 up ou indisponible gere proprement', function () { pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 503) { pm.test('Gateway error code coherent', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'); }); }
